Spell Penetration II: Passive: +2 Equipment bonus to Spell Penetration checks.
Potency +52: Passive: +52 Equipment bonus to each Spell Power.
Electric Resistance +30: Passive: +30 Enhancement bonus to your Electric Resistance.
